The kill-free encounter share of our own corpus was not re-measured for the current pipeline; the prior project measurement has a proximity-encounter denominator and was not re-verified here.
Four inhibitor columns sit in the combat group by a name-matching order in the grouping code; a corrected grouping would require regenerating, not relabelling, the SHAP explanations.
No background/terminology section, no figures and no journal formatting; reviewer request R1-4 remains partial.
Anonymised repository, licence, reproduction instructions and data policy are not prepared (reviewer request R2-4 open).
Author block, affiliations, acknowledgments, funding and ethics statements are intentionally absent and must be supplied by the authors before any submission.
